name: American Legion Auxiliary Jersey Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of New Jersey
city: New Jersey (2026 session at Centenary University)
what_you_do: Spend a short summer session in a mock government. You learn how city, county and state government work by holding pretend offices.
grades: Junior in high school when applying
who_can_apply: Juniors who live or go to school in New Jersey and are legal U.S. residents. You must be fluent in English and able to attend the whole session. You must be willing to take part in nondenominational prayer, patriotic ceremonies, the Pledge and the National Anthem. An Auxiliary unit must sponsor you.
pay_detail: No pay. Sponsors (units, posts or other groups) enroll and sponsor delegates; the site does not list a fee to the student.
duration: About 5 days (2026: Sunday June 21 to Thursday June 25)
deadline_text: 2026 sponsorships were filled and no applicants were being accepted. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Contact a local American Legion Auxiliary unit or a county chairperson to ask for sponsorship. The site lists contacts. You cannot apply without a sponsor.
notes: Girls only. Start asking local Auxiliary units in the winter. The 2026 site says sponsorships were already filled. A matching program for boys (Jersey Boys State) is run by the American Legion.
